concentration_time_figure.caption_quote: Pharmacokinetic profiles of Adnectin C and Adnectin C-PAS#1(200).after administration of 5 mg/kg to BALB/c mice.
concentration_time_figure.note: Plasma concentration vs time after a single 5 mg/kg IV dose; sparse sampling with staggered subgroups over 5 min to 96 h. Table 3 gives the derived T1/2, AUC0-inf, elimination rate constant and clearance.

bioanalytical_method: In-house ('homemade') ELISA: plates coated with recombinant hVEGFR2, plasma samples added, detected with anti-His HRP-conjugated monoclonal antibody and TMB, absorbance at 450 nm
bioanalytical_quote: The concentrations of recombinant proteins in the plasma were determined using a homemade ELISA.
notes: Half-life is reported only as the terminal T1/2 in Table 3 (minutes); no Cmax or Tmax is given anywhere in the body, and Fig. 8 is described only qualitatively in the text. The Methods state three groups of n = 6 (Adnectin C, Adnectin C-PAS#1(200), PBS control) but then describe the blood-sampling schedule in terms of four sub-groups (group I-IV), an internal inconsistency; both are recorded. The animal-approval sentence attributes approval to the 'Institutional Animal Care and Use Committee' in the PK section and to the Animal Ethics Committee of Pasteur Institute of Iran (IR.PII.REC.1397.68) in Reagents. The body does not print the Adnectin C amino acid sequence — the sequence shown in the PEPLIFE2 header is database metadata and was not used. No ex vivo (serum/plasma stability) assay was performed; thermal and freeze-thaw stability were run in PBS/phosphate buffer and are classified as in vitro. The study reports no clearance units beyond mL/min and no body-weight normalisation.
